description_html:
Documentation

3D Model

 

 

Overview

 

The Toy Shooter Components Kit contains all the necessary hardware components for assembling a Toy Shooter. To complete the assembly for an entirely functional piece, users also need to download the model files and 3D print the remaining parts.
 
*This is a cartoon-style toy shooter that does not have any firing capability, only ejecting shells from the top to ensure safe play.
To download the model files and obtain detailed information, please visit the Toy Shooter on MakerWorld.

Notes

1. This toy shooter is designed without any firing capability.
2. Please wear appropriate eye protection such as goggles or safety glasses to prevent any ejected shells or debris from causing eye injuries.
3. It is recommended to use PLA Basic for the printed part. To ensure proper functionality of the feeding mechanism, please avoid using PLA Matte for printing the feeding components.

Product Specifications

Product Weight 17 g Packaging Size 100*69*35 mm
